response.explanation: In production, processes are created via mp_context.Process, where mp_context is multiprocessing.get_context("spawn"). That class is multiprocessing.context.SpawnProcess. It subclasses BaseProcess, not multiprocessing.context.Process, which is what multiprocessing.Process refers to. So `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` is always False for these objects. The old code called self.process.kill() unconditionally. In `_ensure_processes_alive` (lines 253-257), a flusher flagged as "hang" is therefore never killed. A replacement is created via `_create_process_for_shards` while the hung process keeps running, and it still holds its shards. `join()` (line 346) has the same guard, so `process.terminate()` is never called on shutdown either.
response.title: isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is False for spawn-context processes, so hung flushers are never killed
